corrections.reason: The wide Fidel ዡ in እዡ ('its pus/ichor having flowed out', describing a decomposing corpse inside a tomb) was misread as two characters ዝኑ.
First person plural conditional ባልሆንም ነበር (translating Ge'ez እምኢተሣተፍነ) is printed with 6th-order ን at the end of line 15.
Canonical Ge'ez vocative particle ኦ in ኦትውልደ አራዊተ ምድር (Matthew 23:33) was misread as 1st-order አ.
